statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON (green). Tail risk is low at 16% while Stress is high at 73% on FOMC decision day.
recommendation: Tail remains below the block threshold in the current hour, so the deterministic mapping yields EA_ON for both NQ futures and the NAS100 CFD. A narrow evidence-based danger window is flagged from 18:00 to 21:00 UTC, covering the FOMC statement and Summary of Economic Projections, the press conference, and the delayed repricing leg that can follow once the bond market has absorbed all three. Existing-position management and emergency protection remain active throughout.
headline: NQ grinds to a marginal new overnight high inside a 0.58% band; Tail stays low at 16% ahead of a Fed decision priced for the first hike since 2023, with the danger window held at 18:00-21:00 UTC.
body: Observed conditions at the assessment cutoff remain orderly. NQ futures trade at 29,388.00, up 0.48% on the session, inside an overnight band of roughly 29,226.00 to 29,395.50 that spans only about 0.58%. Price sits about 8 points below a marginal new overnight high set during the current hour, on thin volume near 49.8k contracts, after trading at 29,352.00 an hour earlier. That is an advance of some 36 points over the hour, but it was gradual and two-way rather than the repeated extension after failed pullbacks that the Tail score measures, so Tail rises only one point to 16%. Holding close to the session extreme is the single amplifier present, and on its own inside a band this narrow it does not establish a path that denies mean reversion. VIX is 17.20 against a 17.20 prior close, so there is still no volatility bid into the decision. Cash NDX closed the prior session at 28,937.84, down 0.65% in a 28,899.43 to 29,142.80 range, a second consecutive decline, which leaves futures and cash pointing in opposite directions and is treated as conflict rather than alignment. The macro backdrop is what keeps Stress high. The 10-year Treasury yield is 4.97% on the latest H.15 release after touching 5.041% intraday on 15 September, the highest since 2007, with the 2-year at 4.65%. WTI trades near $104.25, down about 1.5%, and Brent near $107.78, both retreating from four-month highs after industry data showed a surprise US crude inventory build of roughly 7.14 million barrels, while loadings at Saudi Arabia's Yanbu port remain suspended following pipeline attacks. Semiconductors remain a live swing factor after the sector index fell sharply on 14 September following an AI-pacing essay, though sell-side work since has questioned that reaction and found no evidence of a hardware rollout slowdown. The FOMC decision, Summary of Economic Projections and press conference arrive between 18:00 and 18:30 UTC with roughly 94% priced for a 25 basis point hike from the current 3.50% to 3.75% target range, which would be the first since 2023, and with major forecasters genuinely split between a hike and a hold. US Retail Sales for August precedes it at 12:30 UTC and had not been released at the assessment cutoff. Under the published method, event importance, forecast dispersion and surprise magnitude raise Stress and affect Confidence rather than Tail until a pathological price path is actually observed. Tail therefore stays low at 16% for the current hour, and protection is concentrated in a narrow 18:00 to 21:00 UTC window rather than applied across the whole session. Shared Finviz cross-asset context was read, was about 33 minutes old and therefore fresh, and was flagged partial with its calendar section unavailable; its delayed futures panel showed NQ, ES and YM modestly higher with Treasury futures firm, volatility futures slightly lower, crude lower and gold higher, and its latest-session panels showed six of eight megacaps lower against five of seven semiconductors higher. That mixed, unaligned picture was used as confirmation of conflict rather than as live price-path evidence, consistent with the contract.

lookbackSummary: Across the past 24 hours the published Claude assessment stayed in a low-to-watch Tail band with persistently high Stress. Tail peaked at 25% in the 08:00 UTC slot on 15 September, the only block-band hour of the window, and spent the European and US sessions between 20% and 24% as the tape ground lower and the 10-year yield pressed to a 2007 high. From 21:00 UTC onward Tail fell through 17% to a 13% to 15% plateau as overnight futures settled into a narrow, orderly band, with the dominant mode shifting from mixed to normal after midnight UTC. Stress never left the high band, holding between 70% and 77% throughout.
outlookSummary: The projection keeps Tail in the low band through the European morning while the narrow overnight band persists, then steps it up in two stages around the session's scheduled catalysts. Conditional Tail reaches the watch band from 12:00 to 14:00 UTC, covering the 12:30 UTC Retail Sales release and the 13:30 UTC US cash open, before easing back through midday. The FOMC sequence carries the only block-band hours: 32% at 18:00 UTC for the decision and Summary of Economic Projections, 33% at 19:00 UTC as press-conference questioning overlaps the bond market repricing the rate path, and 29% at 20:00 UTC for the delayed second leg and the cash close. That defines the 18:00 to 21:00 UTC danger window. From 21:00 UTC conditional Tail decays quickly on the assumption that price discovery proves orderly and retracements occur, returning to a 16% to 17% baseline through the Asian session and into the European morning of 17 September. Stress follows the same arc, peaking at 89% during the press-conference hour and easing to 70% by the end of the horizon. All structure beyond the current clock hour is conditional; only the 07:00 UTC slot reflects observed price-path evidence.
